```{r}
# Performances per athlete
f.perfs.per.athlete <- f.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  summarise(n_perfs = n())

m.perfs.per.athlete <- m.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  summarise(n_perfs = n())

# Performances per season per athlete
f.perfs.per.season <- f.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(n_perfs = n(), .groups = "drop")

m.perfs.per.season <- m.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(n_perfs = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Career length (number of seasons) per athlete
f.career.length <- f.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  summarise(n_seasons = n_distinct(Season))

m.career.length <- m.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  summarise(n_seasons = n_distinct(Season))

# Build the summary table
summary.stats <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c(
    "Performances per athlete",
    "Performances per season per athlete",
    "Career length (seasons)"
  ),
  Female.Mean = c(mean(f.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    mean(f.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    mean(f.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Female.Median = c(median(f.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    median(f.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    median(f.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Female.SD = c(sd(f.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    sd(f.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    sd(f.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Female.Min = c(min(f.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    min(f.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    min(f.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Female.Max = c(max(f.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    max(f.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    max(f.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Male.Mean = c(mean(m.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    mean(m.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    mean(m.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Male.Median = c(median(m.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    median(m.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    median(m.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Male.SD = c(sd(m.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    sd(m.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    sd(m.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Male.Min = c(min(m.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    min(m.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    min(m.career.length$n_seasons)),
  Male.Max = c(max(m.perfs.per.athlete$n_perfs),
                    max(m.perfs.per.season$n_perfs),
                    max(m.career.length$n_seasons))
)

# Round to 1 decimal place
summary.stats[, -1] <- round(summary.stats[, -1], 1)

print(summary.stats)


# PLOT 1: DISTRIBUTION OF RACE TIMES (Density plot)
f.times <- f.swim.data$TimeSeconds
m.times <- m.swim.data$TimeSeconds

f.dens <- density(f.times, na.rm = TRUE)
m.dens <- density(m.times, na.rm = TRUE)

# Set x and y limits to accommodate both
xlim.range <- range(c(f.dens$x, m.dens$x))
ylim.range <- c(0, max(c(f.dens$y, m.dens$y)) * 1.1)

plot(f.dens,
     main = "Distribution of Race Times by Gender",
     xlab = "Time (seconds)", ylab = "Density",
     xlim = xlim.range, ylim = ylim.range,
     col = "palevioletred", lwd = 2)
lines(m.dens, col = "cornflowerblue", lwd = 2)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Female", "Male"),
       col = c("palevioletred", "cornflowerblue"), lwd = 2)


# PLOT 2: SEASON-TO-SEASON VARIABILITY IN SEASON BESTS

# Compute season best per athlete per season
f.season.bests <- f.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(season.best = min(TimeSeconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

m.season.bests <- m.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(season.best = min(TimeSeconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Compute within-athlete SD of season bests
f.sb.sd <- f.season.bests %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  summarise(sb.sd = sd(season.best, na.rm = TRUE))

m.sb.sd <- m.season.bests %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  summarise(sb.sd = sd(season.best, na.rm = TRUE))

# Boxplot comparing the two groups
boxplot(list(Female = f.sb.sd$sb.sd, Male = m.sb.sd$sb.sd),
        main = "Season-to-Season Variability in Season Bests by Gender",
        ylab = "SD of Season Bests (seconds)",
        col = c("palevioletred", "cornflowerblue"),  border = "black")


# PLOT 3: CAREER LENGTH DISTRIBUTION BY GENDER

f.seasons <- f.career.length$n_seasons
m.seasons <- m.career.length$n_seasons

# Set common breaks and x-axis limits
breaks.range <- seq(min(c(f.seasons, m.seasons)) - 0.5, max(c(f.seasons, m.seasons)) + 0.5,
                    by = 1)

xlim.range <- range(breaks.range)
ylim.max   <- max(hist(f.seasons, breaks = breaks.range, plot = FALSE)$counts,
                  hist(m.seasons, breaks = breaks.range, plot = FALSE)$counts) * 1.1


# Female histogram
hist(f.seasons,
     breaks = breaks.range,
     main = "Career Length Distribution: Female Athletes",
     xlab = "Number of Seasons", ylab = "Number of Athletes",
     xlim = xlim.range, ylim = c(0, ylim.max),
     col = "palevioletred", border = "white")

# Male histogram
hist(m.seasons,
     breaks = breaks.range,
     main = "Career Length Distribution: Male Athletes",
     xlab = "Number of Seasons", ylab = "Number of Athletes",
     xlim = xlim.range, ylim = c(0, ylim.max),
     col = "cornflowerblue", border = "white")
```

HYPOTHESIS TESTS
```{r}
# HYPOTHESIS TESTS

# 1. Gender comparison at horizon 1
# Two-sample t-test: female vs male log scores at H1
female_ls_h1 <- results_logscore_clean.f[athletes_h3.f, 1]
male_ls_h1 <- results_logscore_clean_m[athletes_h3.m, 1]

gender_test <- t.test(female_ls_h1, male_ls_h1,
                      alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)
cat("Gender comparison (H1):\n")
print(gender_test)

# 2. Gap vs No Gap at horizon 1
# Female
gap_ls_f <- results_logscore_clean.f[gap_athletes.f, 1]
no_gap_ls_f <- results_logscore_clean.f[no_gap_athletes.f, 1]

gap_test_f <- t.test(gap_ls_f, no_gap_ls_f,
                     alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)
cat("\nFemale gap vs no gap (H1):\n")
print(gap_test_f)

# Male
gap_ls_m <- results_logscore_clean_m[gap_athletes_m, 1]
no_gap_ls_m <- results_logscore_clean_m[no_gap_athletes_m, 1]

gap_test_m <- t.test(gap_ls_m, no_gap_ls_m,
                     alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)
cat("\nMale gap vs no gap (H1):\n")
print(gap_test_m)

# 3. Early gap vs Late gap vs No gap at horizon 1
# Female early/late/no gap ANOVA 
no_gap_f_h3 <- intersect(which(!has_gap.f), athletes_h3.f)
early_gap_f_h3 <- intersect(early_gap_f, athletes_h3.f)
late_gap_f_h3 <- intersect(late_gap_f, athletes_h3.f)

gap_df_f <- data.frame(
  ls = c(results_logscore_clean.f[no_gap_f_h3, 1],
            results_logscore_clean.f[early_gap_f_h3, 1],
            results_logscore_clean.f[late_gap_f_h3, 1]),
  group = c(rep("No Gap", length(no_gap_f_h3)),
            rep("Early Gap", length(early_gap_f_h3)),
            rep("Late Gap", length(late_gap_f_h3)))
  )

# Remove NAs together so vectors stay aligned
gap_df_f <- gap_df_f[!is.na(gap_df_f$ls), ]

cat("Female group sizes after NA removal:\n")
print(table(gap_df_f$group))

anova_gap_f <- aov(ls ~ factor(group), data = gap_df_f)
cat("\nFemale early/late/no gap ANOVA (H1):\n")
print(summary(anova_gap_f))
cat("\nFemale post-hoc pairwise t-tests:\n")
print(TukeyHSD(anova_gap_f))

# Male early/late/no gap ANOVA
gap_df_m <- data.frame(
  ls = c(results_logscore_clean_m[no_gap_m_h3, 1],
            results_logscore_clean_m[early_gap_m_h3, 1],
            results_logscore_clean_m[late_gap_m_h3, 1]),
  group = c(rep("No Gap", length(no_gap_m_h3)),
            rep("Early Gap", length(early_gap_m_h3)),
            rep("Late Gap", length(late_gap_m_h3)))
)

gap_df_m <- gap_df_m[!is.na(gap_df_m$ls), ]

cat("Male group sizes after NA removal:\n")
print(table(gap_df_m$group))

anova_gap_m <- aov(ls ~ factor(group), data = gap_df_m)
cat("\nMale early/late/no gap ANOVA (H1):\n")
print(summary(anova_gap_m))
cat("\nMale post-hoc pairwise t-tests:\n")
print(TukeyHSD(anova_gap_m))

# 4. Horizon comparison
# Female: one-way ANOVA across horizons 1-6
horizon_ls_f <- c()
horizon_id_f <- c()
for (h in 1:6) {
  if (h <= 3) valid <- athletes_h3.f else valid <- athletes_h6.f
  ls_h <- results_logscore_clean.f[valid, h]
  ls_h <- ls_h[!is.na(ls_h)]
  horizon_ls_f <- c(horizon_ls_f, ls_h)
  horizon_id_f <- c(horizon_id_f, rep(h, length(ls_h)))
}
anova_horizon_f <- aov(horizon_ls_f ~ factor(horizon_id_f))
cat("\nFemale horizon comparison ANOVA:\n")
print(summary(anova_horizon_f))

# Male: one-way ANOVA across horizons 1-6
horizon_ls_m <- c()
horizon_id_m <- c()
for (h in 1:6) {
  if (h <= 3) valid <- athletes_h3.m else valid <- athletes_h6.m
  ls_h <- results_logscore_clean_m[valid, h]
  ls_h <- ls_h[!is.na(ls_h)]
  horizon_ls_m <- c(horizon_ls_m, ls_h)
  horizon_id_m <- c(horizon_id_m, rep(h, length(ls_h)))
}
anova_horizon_m <- aov(horizon_ls_m ~ factor(horizon_id_m))
cat("\nMale horizon comparison ANOVA:\n")
print(summary(anova_horizon_m))

# 5. Layer comparison at horizon 1
# These would need the per-athlete layer log scores
# assuming ls_l1, ls_l2, ls_l3 are stored from the layer comparison code
layer_ls_f <- c(ls_l1, ls_l2, ls_l3)
layer_id_f <- c(rep("Layer 1", length(ls_l1)),
                rep("Layer 2", length(ls_l2)),
                rep("Layer 3", length(ls_l3)))

# Remove infinite values
finite_idx <- is.finite(layer_ls_f)
layer_ls_f <- layer_ls_f[finite_idx]
layer_id_f <- layer_id_f[finite_idx]

anova_layer_f <- aov(layer_ls_f ~ factor(layer_id_f))
cat("\nLayer comparison ANOVA (female, H1):\n")
print(summary(anova_layer_f))
cat("\nLayer post-hoc pairwise t-tests:\n")
print(TukeyHSD(anova_layer_f))
```

```{r}
# Rebuild early/late gap classification for males using calendar years
early_gap_m <- c()
late_gap_m  <- c()

for (i in 1:100) {
  if (!has_gap_m[i]) next
  
  years_competed <- sort(unique(m.swim.data$Year[m.swim.data$athlete == i]))
  all_years <- min(years_competed):max(years_competed)
  gap_years <- setdiff(all_years, years_competed)
  
  if (length(gap_years) == 0) next
  
  late_gap <- any(gap_years >= (max(years_competed) - 3))
  
  if (late_gap) {
    late_gap_m <- c(late_gap_m, i)
  } else {
    early_gap_m <- c(early_gap_m, i)
  }
}

cat("Male early gap athletes:", length(early_gap_m), "\n")
cat("Male late gap athletes:", length(late_gap_m), "\n")
cat("Total gap athletes:", length(gap_athletes_m), "\n")

# Intersect with eligible athletes
early_gap_m_h3 <- intersect(early_gap_m, athletes_h3.m)
late_gap_m_h3  <- intersect(late_gap_m, athletes_h3.m)
no_gap_m_h3 <- intersect(which(!has_gap_m), athletes_h3.m)

cat("\nMale eligible group sizes:\n")
cat("No gap:", length(no_gap_m_h3), "\n")
cat("Early gap:", length(early_gap_m_h3), "\n")
cat("Late gap:", length(late_gap_m_h3), "\n")

gap_df_m <- data.frame(
  ls = c(results_logscore_clean_m[no_gap_m_h3, 1],
            results_logscore_clean_m[early_gap_m_h3, 1],
            results_logscore_clean_m[late_gap_m_h3, 1]),
  group = c(rep("No Gap", length(no_gap_m_h3)),
            rep("Early Gap", length(early_gap_m_h3)),
            rep("Late Gap", length(late_gap_m_h3)))
)

gap_df_m <- gap_df_m[!is.na(gap_df_m$ls), ]

anova_gap_m <- aov(ls ~ factor(group), data = gap_df_m)
cat("\nMale early/late/no gap ANOVA (H1):\n")
print(summary(anova_gap_m))
cat("\nMale post-hoc pairwise t-tests:\n")
print(TukeyHSD(anova_gap_m))
```

25m pool performances problem:
```{r}
# Check how many athletes have their season best in a 25m pool
# Female
f.season.bests.50m <- f.swim.data %>%
  filter(Pool25m == 0) %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(season.best.50m = min(TimeSeconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Check if any athlete's overall season best differs from their 50m season best
f.season.bests.all <- f.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(season.best.all = min(TimeSeconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

f.check <- f.season.bests.50m %>%
  left_join(f.season.bests.all, by = c("athlete", "Season")) %>%
  mutate(differs = season.best.50m != season.best.all)

cat("Female athlete-seasons where season best is in 25m pool:",
    sum(f.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Male
m.season.bests.50m <- m.swim.data %>%
  filter(Pool25m == 0) %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(season.best.50m = min(TimeSeconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

m.season.bests.all <- m.swim.data %>%
  group_by(athlete, Season) %>%
  summarise(season.best.all = min(TimeSeconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

m.check <- m.season.bests.50m %>%
  left_join(m.season.bests.all, by = c("athlete", "Season")) %>%
  mutate(differs = season.best.50m != season.best.all)

cat("Male athlete-seasons where season best is in 25m pool:",
    sum(m.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")


# Total athlete-seasons
cat("Total female athlete-seasons:", 
    nrow(f.season.bests.all), "\n")
cat("Female athlete-seasons with 25m season best:", 
    sum(f.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Proportion:", 
    round(sum(f.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(f.season.bests.all), 3), "\n")

cat("\nTotal male athlete-seasons:", 
    nrow(m.season.bests.all), "\n")
cat("Male athlete-seasons with 25m season best:", 
    sum(m.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Proportion:", 
    round(sum(m.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(m.season.bests.all), 3), "\n")

# Also check specifically for the held-out final seasons
# Female
f.final.seasons <- sapply(1:100, function(i) max(season.f[[i]]))
f.final.check <- f.check %>%
  filter(athlete %in% athletes_h3.f) %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  filter(Season == max(Season)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\nFemale athletes whose held-out season best is in 25m pool:",
    sum(f.final.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Male
m.final.check <- m.check %>%
  filter(athlete %in% athletes_h3.m) %>%
  group_by(athlete) %>%
  filter(Season == max(Season)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Male athletes whose held-out season best is in 25m pool:",
    sum(m.final.check$differs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")



# For the affected female athletes, compare 25m and 50m season bests
# in their held-out season
affected_f <- f.final.check$athlete[f.final.check$differs == TRUE]

for (i in affected_f) {
  n_s <- max(season.f[[i]])
  best_all <- min(target.f[[i]][season.f[[i]] == n_s])
  best_50m <- min(f.swim.data$TimeSeconds[
    f.swim.data$athlete == i & 
    f.swim.data$Season == n_s & 
    f.swim.data$Pool25m == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Athlete", i, "- 25m best:", round(best_all, 3), 
      "50m best:", round(best_50m, 3),
      "difference:", round(best_50m - best_all, 3), "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Also recompute naive baselines using 50m bests
naive_log_score_50m <- function(athlete_idx, target_season, gender = "f") {
  if (gender == "f") {
    sb <- f.season.bests.50m %>%
      filter(athlete == athlete_idx, Season < target_season) %>%
      pull(season.best.50m)
    actual <- actual_bests_50m.f[athlete_idx]
  } else {
    sb <- m.season.bests.50m %>%
      filter(athlete == athlete_idx, Season < target_season) %>%
      pull(season.best.50m)
    actual <- actual_bests_50m.m[athlete_idx]
  }
  if (length(sb) < 2 || is.na(actual)) return(NA)
  mu  <- mean(sb, na.rm = TRUE)
  sig <- sd(sb, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sig) || sig == 0) return(NA)
  -dnorm(actual, mu, sig, log = TRUE)
}

  naive_log_score_50m(i, n_seasons_all.f[i], gender = "f")
})

    round(mean(naive_50m.f, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

})
```

```{r}
# Recompute layer calibration for unaffected athletes
nominal_levels <- c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95)

coverage_layers_unaffected.f <- matrix(NA, nrow = 3, ncol = 6)
coverage_layers_unaffected.m <- matrix(NA, nrow = 3, ncol = 6)

for (l in 1:3) {
  for (q_idx in 1:6) {
    q <- nominal_levels[q_idx]
    lo <- (1 - q) / 2
    hi <- 1 - lo
    
    # Female
    covered.f <- sapply(unaffected_h3.f, function(i) {
      pred <- pred_samples_layers.f[, i, l]
      pred <- pred[is.finite(pred)]
      if (length(pred) == 0) return(NA)
      actual <- actual_bests.f[i]
      if (is.na(actual)) return(NA)
      actual >= quantile(pred, lo) & actual <= quantile(pred, hi)
    })
    coverage_layers_unaffected.f[l, q_idx] <- mean(covered.f, na.rm=TRUE)
    
    # Male
    covered.m <- sapply(unaffected_h3.m, function(i) {
      pred <- pred_samples_layers_m[, i, l]
      pred <- pred[is.finite(pred)]
      if (length(pred) == 0) return(NA)
      actual <- actual_bests[i]
      if (is.na(actual)) return(NA)
      actual >= quantile(pred, lo) & actual <= quantile(pred, hi)
    })
    coverage_layers_unaffected.m[l, q_idx] <- mean(covered.m, na.rm=TRUE)
  }
}

cat("Female layer calibration (unaffected athletes):\n")
cat("Nominal levels: 50% 60% 70% 80% 90% 95%\n")
for (l in 1:3) {
  cat(sprintf("Layer %d: %s\n", l,
    paste(round(coverage_layers_unaffected.f[l,], 3), collapse=" ")))
}

cat("\nMale layer calibration (unaffected athletes):\n")
cat("Nominal levels: 50% 60% 70% 80% 90% 95%\n")
for (l in 1:3) {
  cat(sprintf("Layer %d: %s\n", l,
    paste(round(coverage_layers_unaffected.m[l,], 3), collapse=" ")))
}

# Also get the 95% level specifically for reporting in text
cat("\nFemale 95% coverage by layer (unaffected):\n")
cat("Layer 1:", round(coverage_layers_unaffected.f[1, 6], 3), "\n")
cat("Layer 2:", round(coverage_layers_unaffected.f[2, 6], 3), "\n")
cat("Layer 3:", round(coverage_layers_unaffected.f[3, 6], 3), "\n")

cat("\nMale 95% coverage by layer (unaffected):\n")
cat("Layer 1:", round(coverage_layers_unaffected.m[1, 6], 3), "\n")
cat("Layer 2:", round(coverage_layers_unaffected.m[2, 6], 3), "\n")
cat("Layer 3:", round(coverage_layers_unaffected.m[3, 6], 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Correlation between career length and prediction error
# Female - unaffected athletes only
career_lengths_f <- season_counts.f[unaffected_h3.f]
errors_f <- results_error.f[unaffected_h3.f, 1]
valid_f <- !is.na(errors_f)
cat("Female correlation (unaffected):", 
    round(cor(career_lengths_f[valid_f], errors_f[valid_f]), 3), "\n")
```
